metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since the kids loved Inside Out 2, they will enjoy seeing the original adventure that started Riley's emotional journey.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: This sequel to Finding Nemo features the same lovable ocean characters on a fun and heartwarming quest to find Dory's family.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: They watched the first two films; this sequel continues Po's funny, action-packed adventures with even more kung-fu fun.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: A perfect follow-up to Despicable Me, featuring Gru, the girls, and plenty of hilarious Minion antics.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Continuing the fun of the Despicable Me franchise with a new villain and a long-lost twin brother.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A hilarious spin-off focusing entirely on the silly yellow sidekicks the kids loved in Despicable Me.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Frozen II, they'll love seeing how Elsa and Anna's magical story began in the original musical.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: Perfect for kids who enjoyed The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic, featuring arcade game characters on a vibrant adventure.

metas.name: Ralph Breaks the Internet
metas.description: A colorful and humorous sequel filled with popular Disney characters and internet-themed adventures.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A funny and fast-paced animal adventure from the creators of Migration and Despicable Me.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic, beautifully animated Viking-and-dragon friendship story that matches the adventure of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: A spectacular sequel with thrilling flight sequences, emotional depth, and new mystical dragons.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A highly energetic, hilarious, and visually inventive family comedy similar in vibe to Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A charming, sunny Pixar fantasy about friendship and sea monsters, matching the heartwarming vibes of Ponyo.

metas.name: Soul
metas.description: A visually stunning Pixar movie centered on music and life, great for kids who loved Coco and Inside Out.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: An entertaining fantasy road-trip adventure about two elf brothers, full of magic and comedy.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A beloved Pixar classic filled with adorable monsters, laugh-out-loud comedy, and a very sweet heart.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A heartwarming Pixar adventure about a floating house, a talking dog, and an unlikely friendship.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed, heartwarming superhero adventure featuring the giant lovable robot Baymax.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A thrilling and funny superhero family adventure that perfectly blends high-stakes action with relatable family comedy.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious and clever twist on superhero stories that kids who liked Despicable Me and the Sonic films will love.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: An incredibly witty, fast-paced, and creative adventure that matches the style of The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A heartwarming, magical adventure across China about a girl and a lovable Yeti trying to get back home.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A beautiful Studio Ghibli fantasy about tiny people living hidden in a house, matching the charm of My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A sweet, gentle, and highly entertaining animated comedy featuring Charlie Brown and Snoopy.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: A dialogue-free, hilariously clever claymation comedy from the same studio behind Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: An incredibly sweet, funny, and heartwarming live-action/CGI hybrid movie about a polite bear in London.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: An exceptionally joyful, critically acclaimed sequel packed with physical comedy and wholesome family fun.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A colorful prehistoric family adventure filled with wild creature designs and plenty of laugh-out-loud slapstick humor.

metas.name: Babe
metas.description: A delightful, classic family movie about a polite little pig who learns to herd sheep, full of charm and heart.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An incredibly zany, fast-paced, and funny animated film about food falling from the sky like rain.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: An engaging Disney adventure about a TV star dog who thinks he has real superpowers, featuring lots of fun action.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A goofy, high-energy monster-themed family comedy that is spooky-themed but completely friendly and silly.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest and most quotable animated comedies about a selfish emperor turned into a llama.

metas.name: Ferdinand
metas.description: A heartwarming and funny animated film about a giant, gentle bull who prefers smelling flowers to fighting.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic Pixar adventure with colorful bugs, fun team-building, and heroic antics that match Toy Story's charm.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A vibrant, music-filled animated adventure inspired by Chinese folklore, great for fans of Moana and Coco.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical, song-filled Disney animated fantasy celebrating the power of wishes, matching the style of Tangled.

metas.name: Epic
metas.description: A thrilling and visually stunning miniature-world forest adventure that kids who enjoyed The Borrowers will love.
